source.title: Naproxen and Ibuprofen Exposure Alter the Blood-Testis Barrier in a Novel In Vitro Model

model: Primary rhesus-macaque Sertoli cells; three biological replicates per RNA-seq condition.

study_design.rna_seq_exposure: Daily exposure in the study's five-day cell protocol, with a 24-hour pretreatment before seeding.
study_design.differential_expression_threshold: Adjusted p < 0.01 and fold change > 1.5 in either direction, as described by the authors.
notes: Authors describe the highest naproxen and ibuprofen concentrations as exceeding typical human plasma concentrations.
Lower-dose expression profiles were described as broadly similar to their vehicle controls.
Main text reports 142 DEGs at 400 uM naproxen, while the Figure 2 legend reports 158; this count conflict is preserved.

measurements.interpretation: Lower BUB1B transcript signal in this condition; the visible source spreadsheet does not label its effect column, so it is not relabeled as a fold change here.

not_measured: MVA or either nominated BUB1B variant

decision: Direction is opposite to BUB1B restoration at the highest tested concentrations. Retain as an adverse-direction, tissue-specific mechanistic comparator; decline as a treatment lead. Do not infer ordinary-use harm or medical-use advice.

naproxen_sodium.identity_caveat: This CPDat salt-form record is kept separate from the study's naproxen preparation.
